tool_input.prompt: Is BrowserModule.withServerTransition removed or deprecated in Angular 19? What is the migration path / replacement? List any other breaking changes relevant to NgModule-based apps (not standalone), SSR, RouterModule, ngrx compatibility.

result:
Hop 11 (Angular 18 → 19) is complete. Summary:

- Ran `ng update @angular/core@19 @angular/cli@19` successfully; Angular packages moved to 19.2.25, CLI/build-angular to 19.2.27, TypeScript to ~5.8.3, zone.js to ~0.15.1.
- The automated migration added `standalone: false` to all 7 NgModule-declared components (expected, since v19 defaults new components to standalone).
- Found and manually fixed one build break the codemod didn't handle: `BrowserModule.withServerTransition()` was removed in Angular 19, which broke `app.module.ts`'s compile and cascaded into unrelated-looking template errors across the whole app. Fixed with plain `BrowserModule` + an explicit `APP_ID` provider, preserving the original SSR app-id behavior.
- `npm install` and `npm run build` both pass. `npm run test` fails the same pre-existing way as baseline (unrelated `styles.css` path bug in `angular.json`) — no regression.
- Report written to `.upgrade/reports/11-v18-to-v19.json` with status `done`.
